issues.t: appconfig: GetDeployment/GetEnvironment serve State as the model's SCREAMING_SNAKE enum member instead of AWS's PascalCase wire value, so a client's barrier on 'Complete'/'ReadyForDeployment' never releases and the Start

appconfig: 2 net-new causes — a deployment reaches 100%/COMPLETE instantly so no rollout step is ever observable, and FinalBakeTimeInMinutes never holds it in BAKING (so a bake-window StopDeployment is refused)
appconfig: 2 net-new causes — CreateExtension's optimistic-lock ConflictException message is emulator-authored, and a completed deployment's EventLog never records PERCENTAGE_UPDATED

appconfig: 2 net-new causes — an EXPONENTIAL rollout never advances through an observable G*(2^N) progression, and a mid-rollout StopDeployment can never be exercised because no partial rollout state is ever reachable

appconfig: 2 net-new causes — StartExperimentRun accepts an inline treatment override naming an undefined treatment, and a LINEAR rollout is never partial at the data plane so the StopDeployment withdrawal is never reach
appconfig ListExtensions serves a divergent AWS-authored extension catalog
AppConfig StopDeployment's unknown-DeploymentNumber ResourceNotFoundException message omits AWS's service/status/error-code/request-id trailer
AppConfig synthesized response content diverges: deployment EventLog entries and the predefined extension catalog
AppConfigData keeps serving a deleted environment: a pre-deletion configuration token polls successfully forever instead of ResourceNotFoundException
AppConfig request validation and refusal divergences on StartDeployment and GetConfiguration
AppConfig deployment lifecycle advances instantly through deploy, bake and rollback instead of progressing
AppConfig control-plane reads do not resolve application, environment or configuration-profile by Name
AppConfig: 3 net-new causes — Treatments list max over-enforced on Create/UpdateExperimentDefinition, and both optimistic-lock conflict messages are emulator-authored
AppConfig EXPONENTIAL rollout is never partial at the data plane: PercentageComplete is reported but never gates what a configuration session is served
AppConfig serves Deployment.State as the model's SCREAMING_SNAKE member name instead of AWS's CamelCase wire value, so a client's wait for 'Complete' never terminates
AppConfig StartExperimentRun accepts an inline treatment-override naming a treatment the experiment definition does not define
AppConfig rollout percentage never gates what the data plane serves: an in-flight deployment is served to 100% of sessions from StartDeployment onward
AppConfig deployment and experiment state machine: smuggled Type accepted, rollback never finished, LatestDeploymentNumber over-enforced (7 causes)
AppConfig control-plane refusals: wrong error classes and six divergent refusal/validation messages (10 causes)

AppConfig experiment run responses: snapshot treatment keys upper-cased, timestamps as epoch floats, ExposurePercentage omitted

AppConfig DeleteApplication destroys an application that still has experiment definitions instead of refusing with BadRequestException
AppConfig AWS-managed predefined extensions are absent, so ListExtensions is empty and StartDeployment reports no AppliedExtensions
AppConfig DeleteEnvironment cascade-deletes in-flight deployment records, so StopDeployment on the orphaned deployment 404s instead of returning it ROLLED_BACK

AppConfig experiment-run lifecycle: UpdateExperimentRun records no EXPOSURE_UPDATED event, ListExperimentRunEvents returns oldest-first, and updating a terminal run is refused as ConflictException instead of BadRequestEx

AppConfig: GetDeployment not-found message wording, DeleteApplication is not gated on child environments, and a JSON_SCHEMA validator is not evaluated at StartDeployment (3 causes)
AppConfig next-poll token carries no poll-rate obligation and the deployed configuration never reaches the poll loop, so the early-poll refusal is unreachable
AppConfig UpdateExtensionAssociation's not-found and required-parameter refusal messages do not use AWS's templates (2 causes)
